audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 is marked Skill and level 6 is marked Karma in both layers, but the page's own whys say she flips the lane the moment Hookshot lands at 2 and that The Hextech Ultimatum cages Karma at 6. 2+ items is marked Camille while whys[6] calls it a coinflip.
audit.why: Karma's only uncontested window is level 1 before Hookshot exists; from 2 onward a wall-dash erases her range, and the R anchors her into the duel.
audit.corrected: Karma / Camille / Camille / Camille / Camille / Camille / Skill — matching the packet chart and the existing whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claims no danger at 6 and rates it 7/10 for Karma.
audit.why: Mantra is available from level 1 so Karma has no level-6 spike; The Hextech Ultimatum (140/115/90s) is Camille's kill spike.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Camille's at 3/10; her first Sheen item is the next step past Karma's single AP item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Tactical Sweep (W) a true-damage cone. The true damage belongs to Precision Protocol (Q); W's outer half slows, deals extra damage and heals her. Adaptive Defenses is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Misattributed damage type changes what a player buys and how they trade — and Adaptive Defenses shielding against the damage type just used is why chip poke into her autos underperforms.
audit.corrected: True damage attributed to Precision Protocol, healing to the Tactical Sweep outer cone, and Adaptive Defenses named as the reason her trades absorb your poke. Hookshot (16s at rank 1) needs terrain — fighting on open ground denies the second-cast knock-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing despite Tactical Sweep healing her every extended trade.
audit.why: Anti-heal is what makes Karma's chip stick past her first item.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal added to the itemization line.

edits.before: This is Camille's lane now. Her W cone deals true damage that ignores your shield value and heals her, and once E is up she dictates every trade — your RQ burst does not out-damage a Camille who can hookshot on top of you and weave empowered-Q true autos. At 6 her Hextech Ultimatum cages you into a 1v1 you lose, so respect every gank setup and keep Inspire (shield + speed) charged purely to survive her all-in, not to extend a trade. Bait her E onto open ground, side-step the stun, and W-tether her if she lands without a follow-up — that is the only trade you win here.
edits.after: This is Camille's lane now. Tactical Sweep's outer half slows and heals her, Precision Protocol's delayed second cast lands true damage, and Adaptive Defenses shields against whatever type you just used — so your RQ burst does not out-damage a Camille who hookshots on top of you. At 6 The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you into a 1v1 you lose, so keep Inspire charged purely to survive her all-in, never to extend a trade. Bait Hookshot onto open ground where no wall launches the knock-up, then W-tether her if she lands without follow-up — that is the only trade you win.

edits.after: Hit 6 and use The Hextech Ultimatum to anchor you into the 1v1 she always wins

notes: Kit flags mark Camille's R as 'channel/interruptible' and 'untargetable'; Riot's own description is a dash plus an anchoring zone with bonus magic damage on her autos, so per the trust-the-description rule I wrote NO interrupt or untargetable advice, and I did not use the missing-interaction entries built on those two flags. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion. Real name is 'The Hextech Ultimatum' — the page dropped the article in three places, now fixed. Packet sample here is only 19 games at 36.84%; the mirror packet reports 53.7% over 1013 games from Camille's side, so I leaned on kits and the mirror, not the win rate.
